rows.meta_description: Samsung washing machine showing error code AC? Learn what causes this communication fault, how to fix it yourself, and when to call a service technician.
rows.h1: What Does Error Code AC Mean on a Samsung Washing Machine?
rows.description: Error code AC on a Samsung washing machine indicates a communication failure between the main control board and the motor inverter board.
rows.quick_fix: Unplug the washing machine from the wall socket, wait 5 minutes, then plug it back in and restart a wash cycle — this clears the majority of AC errors caused by temporary communication glitches (takes about 5 minutes).
rows.intro_html:
Error code AC points to a breakdown in communication between two key electronic components inside your Samsung washing machine: the main control board (also called the PCB) and the motor inverter board. These two boards constantly exchange signals to coordinate motor speed and drum movement. When that signal is interrupted or lost, the machine stops and displays AC to protect itself from running incorrectly.

When this error appears, the wash cycle will halt and the machine will typically become unresponsive until the fault is cleared. You may notice the display freezing, the drum stopping mid-cycle, or the machine refusing to start at all. In many cases the fault is temporary — caused by a power fluctuation or a brief signal dropout — and a simple reset is all that is needed.

However, if the error returns repeatedly after resetting, there is likely an underlying electrical or hardware problem that needs closer attention. The steps below will help you work through the most common causes in order, from the simplest fix to the more involved ones.

causes_json.detail: A brief power fluctuation or software hiccup can cause the two boards to lose sync momentarily. This is the most common reason for a first-time AC error and usually clears after a full power reset.

The ribbon cable or wiring loom connecting the main control board to the motor inverter board can work loose over time due to vibration. A partially disconnected or corroded connector will cause intermittent or persistent communication failures.

The inverter board controls the motor's speed and direction. If it develops an internal fault — due to a power surge, component failure, or age — it may stop responding to signals from the main board, triggering the AC error.

Less commonly, the main control board itself is the source of the problem. If it cannot send or receive communication signals correctly, the AC error will appear regardless of the condition of the inverter board.

Voltage fluctuations from the mains supply or a faulty power outlet can disrupt the electronics inside the machine. If your home has experienced recent power cuts or surges, this may have triggered or contributed to the fault.

steps_json.action: Perform a full power reset
steps_json.detail: Switch the washing machine off using the power button, then unplug it from the wall socket. Leave it unplugged for at least 5 minutes — this allows the capacitors on the control boards to fully discharge and clears any temporary error states. Plug it back in, select a short wash cycle, and observe whether the AC error returns.

steps_json.action: Check the power outlet and supply
steps_json.detail: Plug another appliance into the same socket to confirm it is working correctly. Avoid using an extension lead or multi-socket adaptor with your washing machine — these can cause voltage drops that affect sensitive electronics. If the socket seems faulty, try a different outlet on a separate circuit.

steps_json.action: Inspect the wiring harness connections
steps_json.detail: Before doing this, unplug the machine from the mains. Remove the back panel of the washing machine (usually held by a few Phillips-head screws) to access the internal boards. Locate the wiring loom running between the main control board and the motor inverter board, and press each connector firmly into place. Look for any signs of burning, corrosion, or broken wires. Refit the panel and test the machine.

steps_json.action: Check for visible damage on both boards
steps_json.detail: With the back panel removed and the machine unplugged, visually inspect both the main control board and the motor inverter board. Look for burnt components, swollen capacitors, scorch marks, or cracked solder joints. Any visible damage is a strong indicator that the affected board needs replacing rather than repairing.

steps_json.action: Test or replace the motor inverter board
steps_json.detail: If the wiring is intact and there is no visible damage, the inverter board is the more likely faulty component of the two. Source a compatible replacement board using your machine's full model number (found on the label inside the door rim). Swap the board, reconnect all wiring carefully, and run a test cycle to confirm the error is resolved.

steps_json.action: Test or replace the main control board
steps_json.detail: If replacing the inverter board does not clear the AC error, the main control board is the next component to address. Again, match the replacement part to your exact model number. If you are not confident working with electronic components, this is the point at which calling a service technician is the safer and more cost-effective option.

rows.when_to_call_technician_html:
If the AC error returns immediately after every reset, or if you have inspected the wiring and found no obvious loose connections, it is likely that one of the control boards has failed internally. Board-level faults are difficult to diagnose without specialist test equipment, and incorrect installation of a replacement board can cause further damage to the machine.

You should also contact a service technician if you notice any burning smell, scorch marks on the boards or wiring, or if the machine trips your home's circuit breaker when switched on. These are signs of a more serious electrical fault that should not be investigated without professional knowledge and tools.
rows.prevention_html:
The AC error is most often linked to electronic component failure or wiring issues rather than user maintenance habits. That said, protecting your machine from power surges by using a surge-protected socket can reduce the risk of board damage over time. Avoid overloading the drum, as excessive vibration can gradually loosen internal wiring connectors.

The parts most commonly replaced when resolving an AC error on Samsung washing machines are the motor inverter board, the main control board (PCB), and the wiring harness connecting the two. Use your full model number when ordering to ensure compatibility.

faq_json.answer: Sometimes, yes. If the error was caused by a temporary power fluctuation or communication dropout, unplugging the machine for 5-10 minutes and restarting it is often enough to clear it. However, if the error reappears on the next cycle or immediately after reset, there is an underlying fault that will not resolve on its own.
faq_json.question: Will the AC error clear itself if I leave the machine for a while?

faq_json.answer: No — when the AC error is active, the machine will stop the cycle and will not operate normally. Attempting to force it to run could cause further damage to the control boards or motor. It is best to resolve the fault before using the machine again.
faq_json.question: Can I still use my washing machine if it shows error code AC?

faq_json.answer: Without specialist diagnostic equipment it can be difficult to tell the two apart. As a general rule, start with the inverter board since it is the more commonly replaced component for the AC error. If replacing it does not fix the problem, the main control board is the next step. A service technician can test both boards with a multimeter to confirm which has failed before any parts are ordered.
faq_json.question: How do I know whether it is the inverter board or the main control board that has failed?

faq_json.answer: They are related but not identical. All three codes point to communication issues between the control board and the inverter board, but AC6 and 1AC are more specific sub-codes that appear on newer Samsung models. The diagnostic approach and likely causes are very similar across all three codes.
faq_json.question: Is error code AC the same as error code AC6 or 1AC on Samsung machines?

faq_json.answer: If a power reset resolves the issue, there is no cost at all. If a board replacement is needed, the inverter board typically costs between £30 and £80 for the part, while the main control board can range from £60 to £150 depending on the model. Add labour costs if you use a service technician. It is worth comparing the repair cost against the age and value of the machine before committing to an expensive board replacement.

rows.meta_description: Visar din Samsung tvättmaskin felkod AC? Lär dig vad som orsakar detta kommunikationsfel, hur du åtgärdar det själv och när du bör kontakta en servicetekniker.
rows.h1: Vad Betyder Felkod AC på en Samsung Tvättmaskin?
rows.description: Felkod AC på en Samsung tvättmaskin indikerar ett kommunikationsfel mellan huvudkortet och motorns inverterarkort.
rows.quick_fix: Dra ut tvättmaskinens stickkontakt ur vägguttaget, vänta 5 minuter, sätt sedan i kontakten igen och starta ett tvättprogram — detta åtgärdar majoriteten av AC-fel som orsakas av tillfälliga kommunikationsstörningar (tar ungefär 5 minuter).
rows.intro_html:
Felkod AC pekar på ett kommunikationsavbrott mellan två viktiga elektroniska komponenter i din Samsung tvättmaskin: huvudkortet (även kallat PCB) och motorns inverterarkort. Dessa två kort utbyter ständigt signaler för att samordna motorhastighet och trummans rörelse. När den signalen avbryts eller försvinner stannar maskinen och visar AC för att skydda sig mot att köra felaktigt.

När detta fel uppstår avbryts tvättcykeln och maskinen slutar vanligtvis att svara tills felet har åtgärdats. Du kan märka att displayen fryser, att trumman stannar mitt i ett program eller att maskinen vägrar starta överhuvudtaget. I många fall är felet tillfälligt — orsakat av en strömfluktuering eller ett kortvarigt signalbortfall — och en enkel återställning är allt som behövs.

Om felet däremot återkommer upprepade gånger efter återställning finns det troligtvis ett underliggande elektriskt eller hårdvaruproblem som kräver noggrannare undersökning. Stegen nedan hjälper dig att gå igenom de vanligaste orsakerna i ordning, från den enklaste lösningen till de mer komplicerade.

causes_json.detail: En kortvarig strömfluktuering eller programvarustörning kan göra att de två korten tillfälligt tappar synkroniseringen. Detta är den vanligaste orsaken till ett första AC-fel och försvinner vanligtvis efter en fullständig strömåterställning.

Bandkabeln eller kabelstammen som förbinder huvudkortet med motorns inverterarkort kan lossna med tiden på grund av vibrationer. En delvis urkopplad eller korroderad kontakt orsakar intermittenta eller ihållande kommunikationsfel.

Inverterarkortet styr motorns hastighet och riktning. Om det utvecklar ett internt fel — på grund av ett strömöverspänning, komponentfel eller ålder — kan det sluta svara på signaler från huvudkortet och utlösa AC-felet.
Mer sällan är huvudkortet självt källan till problemet. Om det inte kan skicka eller ta emot kommunikationssignaler korrekt visas AC-felet oavsett inverterarkortets skick.

Spänningsfluktuationer från elnätet eller ett defekt vägguttag kan störa elektroniken i maskinen. Om ditt hem nyligen har drabbats av strömavbrott eller överspänningar kan detta ha utlöst eller bidragit till felet.

steps_json.action: Utför en fullständig strömåterställning
steps_json.detail: Stäng av tvättmaskinen med strömknappen och dra sedan ut stickkontakten ur vägguttaget. Låt den vara urkopplad i minst 5 minuter — detta låter kondensatorerna på styrkorten laddas ur helt och rensar eventuella tillfälliga feltillstånd. Sätt i kontakten igen, välj ett kort tvättprogram och observera om AC-felet återkommer.

steps_json.action: Kontrollera vägguttaget och strömförsörjningen
steps_json.detail: Anslut en annan apparat till samma uttag för att bekräfta att det fungerar korrekt. Undvik att använda en förlängningssladd eller grenuttag till din tvättmaskin — dessa kan orsaka spänningsfall som påverkar känslig elektronik. Om uttaget verkar defekt, prova ett annat uttag på en separat krets.

steps_json.action: Kontrollera kabelstammens anslutningar
steps_json.detail: Dra ut maskinens stickkontakt ur vägguttaget innan du gör detta. Ta bort bakpanelen på tvättmaskinen (vanligtvis fäst med några Phillips-skruvar) för att komma åt de interna korten. Leta upp kabelstammen som löper mellan huvudkortet och motorns inverterarkort och tryck in varje kontakt ordentligt. Leta efter tecken på brännskador, korrosion eller trasiga ledningar. Sätt tillbaka panelen och testa maskinen.

steps_json.action: Kontrollera båda korten för synliga skador
steps_json.detail: Med bakpanelen borttagen och maskinen urkopplad, inspektera visuellt både huvudkortet och motorns inverterarkort. Leta efter brända komponenter, uppsvällda kondensatorer, brännskador eller spruckna lödfogar. Synliga skador är en tydlig indikation på att det berörda kortet behöver bytas ut snarare än repareras.

steps_json.action: Testa eller byt ut motorns inverterarkort
steps_json.detail: Om kablaget är intakt och det inte finns några synliga skador är inverterarkortet den mer troliga defekta komponenten av de två. Skaffa ett kompatibelt ersättningskort med hjälp av maskinens fullständiga modellnummer (finns på etiketten inuti lucköppningens kant). Byt ut kortet, återanslut all kablage noggrant och kör ett testprogram för att bekräfta att felet är åtgärdat.

steps_json.action: Testa eller byt ut huvudkortet
steps_json.detail: Om byte av inverterarkortet inte åtgärdar AC-felet är huvudkortet nästa komponent att ta itu med. Matcha återigen reservdelen mot ditt exakta modellnummer. Om du inte känner dig trygg med att arbeta med elektroniska komponenter är det vid det här laget säkrare och mer kostnadseffektivt att kontakta en servicetekniker.

rows.when_to_call_technician_html:
Om AC-felet återkommer omedelbart efter varje återställning, eller om du har inspekterat kablaget utan att hitta några uppenbara lösa anslutningar, är det troligt att ett av styrkorten har fått ett internt fel. Fel på kortnivå är svåra att diagnostisera utan specialiserad testutrustning, och felaktig installation av ett ersättningskort kan orsaka ytterligare skador på maskinen.

Du bör också kontakta en servicetekniker om du märker någon bränndoft, brännskador på korten eller kablaget, eller om maskinen löser ut din hemmas säkring när den slås på. Dessa är tecken på ett allvarligare elfel som inte bör undersökas utan professionella kunskaper och verktyg.
rows.prevention_html:
AC-felet är oftast kopplat till elektroniska komponentfel eller kablageproblem snarare än användarens underhållsvanor. Det sagt kan du minska risken för kortskador över tid genom att skydda maskinen mot strömöverspänningar med ett överspänningsskyddat uttag. Undvik att överlasta trumman, eftersom överdrivna vibrationer gradvis kan lossa interna kabelanslutningar.

De delar som oftast byts ut vid åtgärdande av AC-fel på Samsung tvättmaskiner är motorns inverterarkort, huvudkortet (PCB) och kabelstammen som förbinder de två. Använd ditt fullständiga modellnummer när du beställer för att säkerställa kompatibilitet.

faq_json.answer: Ibland, ja. Om felet orsakades av en tillfällig strömfluktuering eller kommunikationsbortfall räcker det ofta att dra ut maskinens stickkontakt i 5–10 minuter och starta om den. Om felet däremot återkommer vid nästa program eller omedelbart efter återställning finns det ett underliggande fel som inte löser sig av sig självt.
faq_json.question: Försvinner AC-felet av sig självt om jag låter maskinen stå ett tag?

faq_json.answer: Nej — när AC-felet är aktivt stannar maskinen programmet och fungerar inte normalt. Att försöka tvinga den att köra kan orsaka ytterligare skador på styrkorten eller motorn. Det är bäst att åtgärda felet innan maskinen används igen.
faq_json.question: Kan jag fortfarande använda min tvättmaskin om den visar felkod AC?

faq_json.answer: Utan specialiserad diagnostikutrustning kan det vara svårt att skilja de två åt. Som en allmän regel, börja med inverterarkortet eftersom det är den komponent som oftast byts ut vid AC-felet. Om byte av det inte löser problemet är huvudkortet nästa steg. En servicetekniker kan testa båda korten med en multimeter för att bekräfta vilket som har gått sönder innan några delar beställs.
faq_json.question: Hur vet jag om det är inverterarkortet eller huvudkortet som har gått sönder?

faq_json.answer: De är besläktade men inte identiska. Alla tre koder pekar på kommunikationsproblem mellan styrkortet och inverterarkortet, men AC6 och 1AC är mer specifika delkoder som visas på nyare Samsung-modeller. Diagnostikmetoden och de troliga orsakerna är mycket lika för alla tre koderna.
faq_json.question: Är felkod AC samma sak som felkod AC6 eller 1AC på Samsung-maskiner?

faq_json.answer: Om en strömåterställning löser problemet kostar det ingenting alls. Om ett kortbyte behövs kostar inverterarkortet vanligtvis mellan 300 och 800 kronor för delen, medan huvudkortet kan kosta mellan 600 och 1 500 kronor beroende på modell. Lägg till arbetskostnad om du anlitar en servicetekniker. Det är värt att jämföra reparationskostnaden med maskinens ålder och värde innan du bestämmer dig för ett dyrt kortbyte.
faq_json.question: Hur mycket kostar det vanligtvis att åtgärda felkod AC på en Samsung tvättmaskin?

rows.title_tag: Samsung Washing Machine Error Code AC3 | Fix It Now
rows.meta_description: Samsung washing machine showing error code AC3? Learn what causes this motor fault, how to fix it yourself, and when to call a service technician.
rows.h1: What Does Error Code AC3 Mean on a Samsung Washing Machine?
rows.description: Error code AC3 on a Samsung washing machine indicates a fault in the motor or drive system, preventing the drum from spinning or agitating correctly.
rows.quick_fix: Check that all wiring connectors to the motor are firmly seated and undamaged — press each connector home until it clicks — then restart the machine to see if the error clears (takes about 10 minutes).
rows.intro_html:
When your Samsung washing machine displays error code AC3, it has detected a problem with the motor or its drive system. This could involve the motor itself, the wiring that supplies it, the drive belt, or the motor control board that tells the motor what to do. The machine's control system monitors motor performance continuously, and when it detects something outside normal parameters, it stops the cycle and displays AC3 to protect the appliance from further damage.

In practical terms, you'll usually notice the drum has stopped spinning or agitating, or the machine halts mid-cycle without completing the wash. In some cases the drum may move sluggishly or make unusual noises before the error appears. The machine will not resume until the underlying fault is identified and resolved.

Some causes of AC3 are straightforward to check yourself, such as loose wiring connections or a worn drive belt. Others — particularly motor brush replacement or a faulty control board — will require a service technician. Work through the steps below in order before calling for professional help.

causes_json.detail: Vibration from normal use can loosen the electrical connectors that run between the motor and the control board. A connector that has worked loose or a wire that has chafed through will interrupt the motor circuit and trigger AC3.

Many Samsung washing machine motors use carbon brushes to transfer current to the rotating part of the motor. These brushes wear down gradually over time and, once too short, cause intermittent or complete loss of motor function.

The drive belt transfers rotation from the motor to the drum. If the belt has snapped, slipped off its pulleys, or stretched to the point where it slips under load, the motor runs but the drum does not respond as expected.

The motor control board regulates the speed and direction of the motor. A failed component on this board — often caused by a power surge or age-related wear — can produce incorrect signals or no signal at all, resulting in AC3.

In less common cases the motor itself has developed an internal fault such as a burnt-out winding or seized bearing. This is more likely on older machines or those that have been run with worn brushes for an extended period.

steps_json.action: Power off and unplug the machine
steps_json.detail: Switch the washing machine off at the control panel, then unplug it from the wall socket. Wait at least two minutes before opening any panels. This is essential for safety whenever you are working near electrical components or the motor.

steps_json.action: Restart the machine to rule out a temporary glitch
steps_json.detail: Plug the machine back in, select a short spin cycle, and observe whether AC3 reappears immediately. Occasionally a one-off voltage fluctuation can trigger the error without an underlying mechanical fault. If the error does not return, monitor the machine over the next few washes before investigating further.

steps_json.action: Inspect the motor wiring connections
steps_json.detail: Remove the back panel of the machine (usually held by four or five screws around the perimeter). Locate the motor — it sits beneath the drum — and trace the wiring harness from the motor up to the control board. Press each connector firmly until it clicks into place, and look for any wires that appear burnt, pinched, or have bare copper showing. Reconnect the panel, plug in, and test.

steps_json.action: Check the drive belt
steps_json.detail: With the back panel still removed, look at the large pulley on the rear of the drum and the smaller pulley on the motor. The belt should sit snugly in the grooves of both pulleys with no slack, cracking, or fraying. If the belt has snapped it will be lying loose at the bottom of the cabinet. A replacement belt is a straightforward DIY repair — note the belt size printed on the old one before ordering.

steps_json.action: Inspect the motor brushes
steps_json.detail: The carbon brushes are located in small plastic holders on either side of the motor body and are usually accessible without fully removing the motor. Slide each brush out and measure its length — if either brush is shorter than approximately 1 cm, both should be replaced as a pair. New brushes are inexpensive and widely available for most Samsung models.

steps_json.action: Test the motor for visible damage
steps_json.detail: Look at the motor body for signs of burning, a smell of scorched insulation, or a seized shaft that will not turn freely by hand. If any of these are present, the motor itself has failed and will need to be replaced — this is a job best handled by a service technician given the complexity of motor removal and the cost of the part.

steps_json.action: Check the motor control board
steps_json.detail: If all mechanical components appear sound, the motor control board is the remaining suspect. Locate the board (usually mounted on the rear or base of the machine) and inspect it for burnt components, bulging capacitors, or scorch marks. Do not attempt to repair the board yourself — if damage is visible, or if all other steps have failed to resolve AC3, contact a service technician for diagnosis and replacement.

rows.when_to_call_technician_html:
If you have checked the wiring connections and drive belt and the error persists, the fault is most likely with the motor brushes, the motor itself, or the motor control board. Replacing motor brushes is within reach of a confident DIYer, but if the motor shows signs of burning or the shaft is seized, a service technician should carry out the replacement. Similarly, motor control board diagnosis requires specialist test equipment to confirm the fault before an expensive part is ordered.

You should also call a service technician if the machine trips your household circuit breaker when you attempt to run it, or if you notice a burning smell during operation. These symptoms suggest an electrical fault that could be a safety risk if the machine continues to be used.
rows.prevention_html:
The parts most commonly replaced when resolving an AC3 error are the motor carbon brushes, the drive belt, and the motor control board. Brushes and belts are wear items with a finite lifespan, so keeping a note of when they were last replaced can help you anticipate future faults. The motor control board is less predictable but is more likely to fail on machines that have experienced power surges — fitting a surge-protected extension lead is a simple precaution.

Search for compatible parts for your specific Samsung model using the tool below. Always match parts to your full model number, which is printed on the label inside the door aperture.

faq_json.answer: No — you should not run the machine while AC3 is active. The error means the motor or drive system is not functioning correctly, and continuing to operate it risks causing further damage to the motor, control board, or drum bearings. Unplug the machine until the fault has been identified and resolved.
faq_json.question: Can I still use my Samsung washing machine while it shows AC3?

faq_json.answer: Motor brushes typically last between five and ten years depending on how frequently the machine is used and what wash programmes are selected. High-spin cycles place more demand on the motor and can shorten brush life. If your machine is more than seven years old and showing AC3, worn brushes are a very likely cause.
faq_json.question: How long do motor brushes last on a Samsung washing machine?

faq_json.answer: Samsung uses several motor-related error codes, and AC3 specifically points to a motor or drive system fault rather than, for example, a door lock or water supply issue. If you see a different code alongside AC3, note both down before starting diagnosis, as they may point to a related problem such as a wiring fault affecting multiple components.
faq_json.question: Is AC3 the same as other motor error codes on Samsung machines?

faq_json.answer: The cost depends on the faulty component. Motor brushes are typically inexpensive — often under £15 for a pair — and can be a DIY repair. A drive belt is similarly affordable. A replacement motor or motor control board is significantly more expensive, and when you add labour costs for a service technician, it is worth comparing the repair cost against the age and value of the machine before proceeding.
faq_json.question: How much does it cost to fix an AC3 error on a Samsung washing machine?

faq_json.answer: A power reset — unplugging for two minutes and restarting — can occasionally clear AC3 if it was triggered by a temporary voltage issue rather than a mechanical fault. However, if the underlying cause is worn brushes, a damaged belt, or a faulty board, the error will return as soon as the machine attempts to run the motor again. A reset is worth trying first, but should not be relied upon as a fix.
faq_json.question: Will resetting my Samsung washing machine clear the AC3 error?
